【Let's Talk About Session 1: 3/11】

Welcome to Let's Talk About 

★Topic: Cultural Festivals 
Festivals are a great way to celebrate culture and traditions! From Halloween to Taiwan's Lantern Festival, they bring people together. Have you experienced a memorable festival? What are the key ones in your culture? Let’s share and describe our favorites in Let’s Talk About!

 Earn NDHU Interdisplinary Self Learning Credits!
Limited seats (10 only) —join us now!
Date: March 11 (Tuesday)
Time: 12:15 - 13:15
Held Online (Google Meet link to be sent after registration)
Host: Dhoni

歡迎參加「Let's Talk About」！ 

 本週主題：文化節慶 
節日是展現文化與傳統的美好方式！從萬聖節到台灣燈會，這些慶典讓人們齊聚一堂，共同歡慶。你是否有過難忘的節日體驗？在你的文化中，有哪些重要的節日呢？來和我們一起分享、交流吧！

參與「Let's Talk About」可獲得東華大學跨域自主學習時數喔！
名額有限（10名），快來報名！
